essence: The remembered mantra for Vāsudeva is oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya.
One should write each syllable of namaḥ separately in the middle of the petals.
One should write aṃ and the other seed syllables in sequence outside the sixteen-petaled lotus.
The syllables of Rāma’s anuṣṭubh should be placed in the eastern parts of the petals.
The formula petitions Rāma to protect the speaker and bestow prosperity.
